description: Implementation of CustomerService interface handling customer-related operations such as retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, including address geolocation integration.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class providing customer-related business logic, including CRUD operations and address geolocation.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the provided first name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a customer by their unique identifier.

methods.name: getByNick with storeId
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname within a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore with criteria
methods.description: Lists customers in a store matching given criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Returns the address based on IP geolocation, handles exceptions via ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer record, with logging.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer and associated attributes.
